description: Packages of the Flutter Bond framework: dependency injection with service providers (bond_core), networking with BondFire (bond_network), caching (bond_cache), forms and validation (bond_form with Riverpod, GetX and Bloc adapters), notifications (bond_notifications) and app analytics (bond_app_analytics).
rules: The 0.1 line (bond_core, bond_cache, bond_network, bond_form and its adapters 0.1.x; bond_notifications and bond_app_analytics 0.2.x) requires Dart 3.13 and Flutter 3.47.7 or newer.
bond_core 0.1 uses package:material_ui types: import package:material_ui/material_ui.dart instead of package:flutter/material.dart.
Register services in a ServiceProvider (Future<void> register(GetIt it)) and resolve them with sl<T>(); JSON factories go in ResponseDecoding.factories.
BondFire() returns a new instance on every call: register it once with it.registerLazySingleton<BondFire>(BondFire.new) and use sl<BondFire>().
Pass .errorFactory(ServerError.fromJson) to every BondFire request so failures surface as ServerError.

bond_form_riverpod 0.1 targets Riverpod 3: extend FormStateNotifier and declare the provider with NotifierProvider.autoDispose; family forms take their argument through the constructor (MyForm(super.arg)).
Upgrading from the 0.0.x packages: follow MIGRATION.md.
